content.value_statement: Debugging can fail when observations, fixes, and cleanup are not connected. This skill guides a repeatable investigation with temporary logs, validation, and removal of debug changes.
actual_capabilities: Parses debugging requests and optional Playwright flags.
Builds up to five evidence-based hypotheses for a reported issue.
Adds marked temporary debug logs for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, and Kotlin.
Uses Playwright MCP to collect browser console, network, screenshot, and DOM evidence when enabled.
Checks adjacent call sites, contracts, and shared state before applying a fix.
Removes only marked debug logs and verifies cleanup with a targeted search.
limitations: It does not replace a security review or a general code review.
It depends on reproducible symptoms, relevant logs, and available project access.
Browser investigation requires a connected Playwright MCP server and a web UI target.
It does not diagnose performance optimization requests or implement unrelated features.

use_cases.title: Resolve a backend exception
use_cases.description: Investigate an error message, add temporary masked logs, identify the failing path, and validate a focused fix.

use_cases.title: Reproduce a browser defect
use_cases.description: Use Playwright evidence to investigate a UI scenario, compare results after a fix, and report the outcome.

use_cases.title: Guide an incident handoff
use_cases.description: Create a structured record of hypotheses, evidence, root cause, validation, and cleanup for a recurring defect.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: investigate an error
prompt_templates.prompt: Debug this error: [paste the error message]. The issue occurs when [describe the action].

prompt_templates.title: Add diagnostic logs
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me debug [describe the symptom]. Add temporary, masked debug logs only where needed and wait for my results.
prompt_templates.scenario: A defect that needs runtime evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a web UI flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Debug this web UI issue with --pw: [URL and reproduction steps]. Use the browser evidence to identify the root cause.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: validate a suspected regression
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate this regression: [symptom]. Check likely call sites, data contracts, and shared state before proposing a minimal fix and validation plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: A change that may affect multiple boundaries.

output_examples.input: Debug an error that occurs after saving a profile.
output: Analysis: lists the most likely files and reasons.
Logging plan: identifies marked fields to observe and mask.
Next step: asks for the resulting logs before changing code.

output_examples.input: Debug a checkout page that fails after clicking Pay with --pw.
output: Browser evidence: summarizes console and network observations.
Root cause: identifies the relevant file and behavior.
Validation: reports the rerun result, regression checks, and debug-log cleanup.

best_practices: Provide a reproducible symptom, error output, and affected environment.
Review proposed log locations and ensure sensitive values are masked before running the application.
Run validation in a local or test environment before applying changes to production systems.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for a general code review or an unrelated feature request.
Do not continue to root-cause analysis before collecting the requested diagnostic evidence.
Do not leave temporary debug logs in the code after the issue is resolved.

faq.question: What problems is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for reproducible software defects, errors, and unexpected behavior that need evidence-based diagnosis.

faq.question: Which languages can it use for temporary logs?
faq.answer: It provides logging conventions for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, and Kotlin.

faq.question: What does the Playwright mode do?
faq.answer: It uses connected Playwright MCP tools to gather browser console, network, screenshot, and DOM evidence.

faq.question: Will it modify my test or secret files?
faq.answer: The workflow prohibits inserting logs into test files, CI configuration, .env files, and secrets files.

faq.question: Does it remove existing debug logs?
faq.answer: No. It removes only logs paired with its explicit DEBUG-INSERTED marker.

faq.question: When should I not use this skill?
faq.answer: Do not use it for simple reviews, feature implementation, performance work, or fixes with an already confirmed cause.
